settings.heading: Stick. Click. Breathe.
settings.text: Three steps, about two seconds. Here’s how Noctara opens your nose without anything going inside it.

settings.heading: Two parts. One click.
settings.text: Small tabs stick to each side of your nose. The magnetic band clicks on and gently pulls them outward to open your airway.

settings.title: Opens wider
settings.text: Magnetic lift expands from the sides

settings.title: Strips collapse
settings.text: Pull from the bridge, fold in when you breathe in

settings.text: Built for training and all-night wear

settings.title: Strips peel off
settings.text: Slip with sweat and skin oils

settings.title: Reusable band
settings.text: Only replace the tabs — less waste

settings.heading: Opens wider, holds stronger, and never collapses.

settings.q: How do I put it on?
settings.a: Stick one tab on each side of your nostrils, then snap the band on. The magnets click into place in about 2 seconds.

settings.q: Which tab size do I need?
settings.a: Every kit includes all 6 sizes (XS–XXL). Start with Medium and size up or down until it feels right.
Noctara helps you breathe through your nose, which many people find reduces nose-related snoring. It is not a medical device and doesn’t treat sleep apnea — talk to a doctor if you think you have it.

settings.q: Can I wear it while working out?
settings.a: Yes. The tabs are sweat-resistant and the band is light, so it stays put through runs, lifts and rides.

settings.q: How long do the tabs last?
settings.a: Each pair of tabs is for one use. The band is reusable — just reorder tabs.
